paragraphs.text: And working together [with him] we entreat also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain
paragraphs.original: Συνεργοῦντες δὲ καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν μὴ εἰς κενὸν τὴν χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ δέξασθαι ὑμᾶς·
paragraphs.translit: Synergountes de kai parakaloumen mē eis kenon tēn charin tou theou dexasthai hymas·

paragraphs.text: (for he saith, At an acceptable time I hearkened unto thee, And in a day of salvation did I succor thee:     behold, now is the acceptable time; behold, now is the day of salvation):
paragraphs.original: λέγει γάρ· Καιρῷ δεκτῷ ἐπήκουσά σου καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ σωτηρίας ἐβοήθησά σοι· ἰδοὺ νῦν καιρὸς εὐπρόσδεκτος, ἰδοὺ νῦν ἡμέρα σωτηρίας·
paragraphs.translit: legei gar· Kairō dektō epēkousa sou kai en hēmera sōtērias eboēthēsa soi· idou nyn kairos euprosdektos, idou nyn hēmera sōtērias·

paragraphs.text: giving no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our ministration be not blamed;
paragraphs.original: μηδεμίαν ἐν μηδενὶ διδόντες προσκοπήν, ἵνα μὴ μωμηθῇ ἡ διακονία,
paragraphs.translit: mēdemian en mēdeni didontes proskopēn, hina mē mōmēthē hē diakonia,

paragraphs.text: but in everything commending ourselves, as ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
paragraphs.original: ἀλλʼ ἐν παντὶ συνιστάνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ὡς θεοῦ διάκονοι· ἐν ὑπομονῇ πολλῇ, ἐν θλίψεσιν, ἐν ἀνάγκαις, ἐν στενοχωρίαις,
paragraphs.translit: allʼ en panti synistanontes heautous hōs theou diakonoi· en hypomonē pollē, en thlipsesin, en anankais, en stenochōriais,

paragraphs.text: in stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;
paragraphs.original: ἐν πληγαῖς, ἐν φυλακαῖς, ἐν ἀκαταστασίαις, ἐν κόποις, ἐν ἀγρυπνίαις, ἐν νηστείαις,
paragraphs.translit: en plēgais, en phylakais, en akatastasiais, en kopois, en agrypniais, en nēsteiais,

paragraphs.text: in pureness, in knowledge, in long suffering, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in love unfeigned,
paragraphs.original: ἐν ἁγνότητι, ἐν γνώσει, ἐν μακροθυμίᾳ, ἐν χρηστότητι, ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ, ἐν ἀγάπῃ ἀνυποκρίτῳ,
paragraphs.translit: en hagnotēti, en gnōsei, en makrothymia, en chrēstotēti, en pneumati hagiō, en agapē anypokritō,

paragraphs.text: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
paragraphs.original: ἐν λόγῳ ἀληθείας, ἐν δυνάμει θεοῦ· διὰ τῶν ὅπλων τῆς δικαιοσύνης τῶν δεξιῶν καὶ ἀριστερῶν,
paragraphs.translit: en logō alētheias, en dynamei theou· dia tōn hoplōn tēs dikaiosynēs tōn dexiōn kai aristerōn,

paragraphs.text: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and [yet] true;
paragraphs.original: διὰ δόξης καὶ ἀτιμίας, διὰ δυσφημίας καὶ εὐφημίας· ὡς πλάνοι καὶ ἀληθεῖς,
paragraphs.translit: dia doxēs kai atimias, dia dysphēmias kai euphēmias· hōs planoi kai alētheis,

paragraphs.text: as unknown, and [yet] well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
paragraphs.original: ὡς ἀγνοούμενοι καὶ ἐπιγινωσκόμενοι, ὡς ἀποθνῄσκοντες καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶμεν, ὡς παιδευόμενοι καὶ μὴ θανατούμενοι,
paragraphs.translit: hōs agnooumenoi kai epiginōskomenoi, hōs apothnēskontes kai idou zōmen, hōs paideuomenoi kai mē thanatoumenoi,

paragraphs.text: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and [yet] possessing all things.
paragraphs.original: ὡς λυπούμενοι ἀεὶ δὲ χαίροντες, ὡς πτωχοὶ πολλοὺς δὲ πλουτίζοντες, ὡς μηδὲν ἔχοντες καὶ πάντα κατέχοντες.
paragraphs.translit: hōs lypoumenoi aei de chairontes, hōs ptōchoi pollous de ploutizontes, hōs mēden echontes kai panta katechontes.

paragraphs.text: Our mouth is open unto you, O Corinthians, our heart is enlarged.
paragraphs.original: Τὸ στόμα ἡμῶν ἀνέῳγεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, Κορίνθιοι, ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν πεπλάτυνται·
paragraphs.translit: To stoma hēmōn aneōgen pros hymas, Korinthioi, hē kardia hēmōn peplatyntai·

paragraphs.text: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own affections.
paragraphs.original: οὐ στενοχωρεῖσθε ἐν ἡμῖν, στενοχωρεῖσθε δὲ ἐν τοῖς σπλάγχνοις ὑμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: ou stenochōreisthe en hēmin, stenochōreisthe de en tois splanchnois hymōn·

paragraphs.text: Now for a recompense in like kind (I speak as unto [my] children), be ye also enlarged.
paragraphs.original: τὴν δὲ αὐτὴν ἀντιμισθίαν, ὡς τέκνοις λέγω, πλατύνθητε καὶ ὑμεῖς.
paragraphs.translit: tēn de autēn antimisthian, hōs teknois legō, platynthēte kai hymeis.

paragraphs.text: Be not unequally yoked with unbelievers: for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? or what communion hath light with darkness?
paragraphs.original: Μὴ γίνεσθε ἑτεροζυγοῦντες ἀπίστοις· τίς γὰρ μετοχὴ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀνομίᾳ, ἢ τίς κοινωνία φωτὶ πρὸς σκότος;
paragraphs.translit: Mē ginesthe heterozygountes apistois· tis gar metochē dikaiosynē kai anomia, ē tis koinōnia phōti pros skotos;

paragraphs.text: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what portion hath a believer with an unbeliever?
paragraphs.original: τίς δὲ συμφώνησις Χριστοῦ πρὸς Βελιάρ, ἢ τίς μερὶς πιστῷ μετὰ ἀπίστου;
paragraphs.translit: tis de symphōnēsis Christou pros Beliar, ē tis meris pistō meta apistou;

paragraphs.text: And what agreement hath a temple of God with idols? for we are a temple of the living God; even as God said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
paragraphs.original: τίς δὲ συγκατάθεσις ναῷ θεοῦ μετὰ εἰδώλων; ἡμεῖς γὰρ ναὸς θεοῦ ἐσμεν ζῶντος· καθὼς εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς ὅτι Ἐνοικήσω ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐμπεριπατήσω, καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτῶν θεός, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μου λαός.
paragraphs.translit: tis de synkatathesis naō theou meta eidōlōn; hēmeis gar naos theou esmen zōntos· kathōs eipen ho theos hoti Enoikēsō en autois kai emperipatēsō, kai esomai autōn theos, kai autoi esontai mou laos.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore Come ye out from among them, and be ye separate,     saith the Lord, And touch no unclean thing; And I will receive you,
paragraphs.original: διὸ ἐξέλθατε ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν, καὶ ἀφορίσθητε, λέγει κύριος, καὶ ἀκαθάρτου μὴ ἅπτεσθε· κἀγὼ εἰσδέξομαι ὑμᾶς·
paragraphs.translit: dio exelthate ek mesou autōn, kai aphoristhēte, legei kyrios, kai akathartou mē haptesthe· kagō eisdexomai hymas·

paragraphs.text: And will be to you a Father, And ye shall be to me sons and daughters,     saith the Lord Almighty.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἔσομαι ὑμῖν εἰς πατέρα, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔσεσθέ μοι εἰς υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας, λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ.
paragraphs.translit: kai esomai hymin eis patera, kai hymeis esesthe moi eis hyious kai thygateras, legei kyrios pantokratōr.
